definitions.gloss: applause and cheers; enthusiastic acclaim; thunderous ovation
definitions.explanation: The act of clapping hands and cheering loudly to show approval or admiration. Implies an enthusiastic, wholehearted response from an audience.

examples.japanese: {会場|かいじょう}は{拍手喝采|はくしゅかっさい}に{包|つつ}まれた。
examples.english: The venue was filled with applause and cheers.

examples.japanese: {演奏|えんそう}が{終|お}わると{観客|かんきゃく}は{拍手喝采|はくしゅかっさい}を{送|おく}った。
examples.english: When the performance ended, the audience gave a thunderous ovation.

examples.japanese: {選手|せんしゅ}がゴールを{決|き}めた{瞬間|しゅんかん}、スタジアム{中|じゅう}が{拍手喝采|はくしゅかっさい}で{沸|わ}き{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: The moment the player scored a goal, the entire stadium erupted in applause and cheers.

notes:
A four-character compound ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}) combining {拍手|はくしゅ} (clapping) and {喝采|かっさい} (cheering, acclaim). The two components reinforce each other to express enthusiastic approval.

Often used with する to form a verb: {拍手喝采|はくしゅかっさい}する.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {拍手喝采|はくしゅかっさい}を{浴|あ}びる (to receive an ovation)
- {拍手喝采|はくしゅかっさい}を{送|おく}る (to give an ovation)
- {拍手喝采|はくしゅかっさい}に{包|つつ}まれる (to be enveloped in applause)
- {拍手喝采|はくしゅかっさい}で{迎|むか}える (to greet with applause)
